note: Relationships between tracker entries, each cited to a clause of the tracker. Type keys: template (drafting family), succession (predecessor, successor, amendment, vehicle), fedstate (preemption, targeting, reciprocity, threshold lineage), executive (an order or directive drives a later action), litigation (challenge, intervention, exhibit, negative finding), assurance (auditor and verifier layer), actor (sponsor, supporter, opponent, party). dashed=true marks links the tracker itself qualifies as unproven, asserted, or negative.
